mission_08: Impressive! You have implemented logical constraints directly into neural network training using CNF formulas. Your network evaluates clause satisfaction using probabilistic logic, computes logic loss as the negative log of satisfaction, and backpropagates gradients through both data and logic objectives. This ensures that predictions not only fit the training data but also respect domain-specific logical rules. The CNF formulation is expressive enough to encode mutual exclusion, implication, equivalence, and other common constraints. This approach is particularly valuable when certain output combinations are logically impossible or undesirable — such as a patient being simultaneously diagnosed with mutually exclusive conditions, or a product being classified into multiple incompatible categories.
